report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.recording claim, both ordinary implementation entries (main.rs and review.rs), all eight ordinary associated test functions, and captured fixture helpers/additional test context. There are no TODO/N/A entries or deferral rationales. Historical rationale describes an obsolete format and was not reused as evidence.

Implementation inspection: main.rs parses the supplied file as deny-unknown-fields ValidationOutput and delegates to record. record rejects blank reviewer/report/edits, obtains current inventory and rejects unknown anchors, validates a safe anchor directory and summary identity/schema/policy, requires an unfinished summary with no existing output, deserializes saved input, and runs input_errors before writing. input_errors compares complete association metadata and initial fragments, resolves every appended selector and compares exact contents. Thus changed or missing source cannot silently replace reviewed input. All essential recording, freshness, publication, and acceptance logic is in the associated review.rs file. Inventory extraction is shared infrastructure, not missing recording-specific implementation association.

Success writes output then recording time in summary without writing input. All start/read/record/load operations lock the validations directory; start removes the previous directory before publishing fresh input, and load_saved treats a null recording time as unfinished and a completed summary with missing/invalid output as invalid. These behaviors prevent partial publication or interleaved attempts from being accepted. Only the selected directory is modified. validate/acceptable reject requested edits even though record permits saving them. Source inspection found no production defect.

Associated test assessment: checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records asserts byte preservation of another obsolete record during recording; restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged asserts preservation of all three files of another active record and final validity. cli_start_and_record_roundtrip_exact_saved_input exercises CLI success and malformed argument rejection, but its input equality assertion is BEFORE recording. disappeared_or_invalidated_additional_fragments_reject_recording asserts deleted dependencies/out-of-bounds ranges reject recording with no output and exact original input bytes. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review covers absent active review, blank report fields/edits, changed implementation, no input substitution, and successful saving of requested edits while gate remains failing. incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate covers output-before-summary, completed-summary/missing-output, and malformed output.

The newly associated start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required visibly asserts exact input preservation after successful recording, recording timestamp, and rejection of an already completed review. These aspects are now covered. The additional record_rejects_invalid_active_identity_and_changed_associations directly tests all six remaining rejection cases: unknown anchor, missing input, mismatched summary anchor, unsupported schema, unsupported policy, and test cfg association change while test text stays identical. Each case asserts recording error, no output, null completion timestamp, and failing gate. The cfg case also asserts the originally captured input is unchanged before the rejection; exact preservation on record is independently exercised by the success and stale-input tests. This provides substantive coverage of each requirement rather than relying on comments or gate-only tests. No requested edits remain. The eight-test set covers publication, rejected and successful recording, freshness and metadata, other records, and pending requested edits as a whole.

Execution: Ran review start/read to capture current inputs, cargo fmt --check (passed), and source searches for quality checks; will run review record for this report. Did not execute behavioral tests or modify Rust. Parent reports 31 review tests, 331 functional tests, and cargo build passed; these are separately reported evidence. Fresh source inspection compared unchanged review.rs against the already inspected complete file, inspected main.rs changes and all eight current test fragments, and recaptured fixture dependencies. Independent post-codegen and Sage sanity inspection of the newly authored rejection test found no issues: no mutex or unsafe code, no meaningful duplicated logic, no workspace-enum catch-all, no inference/error-type construction, and rationale comments are appropriate. Documentation checks are inapplicable to this test-only change.
